card.name: Linking words before climate change
card.fires_on: Small linking words (against, of, to, a, global, on) right before an expected 'climate change' or 'global warming' in web text about environment and energy.

modes.label: Prepositions before climate
modes.description: A preposition or article that directly precedes 'climate change' or 'global warming'.
modes.example: Part of this support comes from those who see nuclear energy as key in the fight<< against>> climate change.

modes.label: The word global before warming
modes.example: They are primarily responsible for the problem of<< global>> warming whose maximum adverse effects will be borne

modes.label: Partial word counteract
modes.description: The start of 'counteract' before climate change.
modes.example: The need for a legally binding agreement to counter<<act>> climate change was deferred for later, possibly

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'climate' (and Chinese climate terms) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'climate change' or 'global warming' is expected.
